name: Cocoa
read: Cocoa Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 5413, 80 days to expiry 2027-02-12): at-the-money implied vol 42.7%, +1.4 pts vs 2026-11-18. 20-day realized vol 39.4%, so options trade at a premium of 3.3 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +8.0 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-11 to 2026-11-24) call open interest fell 69,495 and puts fell 32,256; put/call OI 0.45 → 0.44, front futures 5046 → 5413. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +1,867 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 40.1% → 40.6%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 6000 calls (6,102 lots) and 4500 puts (3,932). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 5500 calls +1,308; Mar 27 6500 calls +1,089. Biggest cut: Mar 27 7500 calls -955.
